review_comments.body: can it be more future-proof if you just do "claud-opus-5", etc. prefixes? rather than 5-5

Good idea, done in f1f5ee2f: the list is now `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5` and `claude-fable-5`, so a later 5.x release gets `tool_choice: auto` without another update. That also sends `auto` to Opus 5, Sonnet 5 and Fable 5, which would accept the forced choice. It costs nothing there, because `output_format` is still the only tool and the text fallback covers a plain-text answer. Haiku 5.5 accepts a forced choice, so it keeps it. The test now covers `claude-sonnet-4-6` and `claude-haiku-5-5` (forced) and a hypothetical `claude-opus-5-6` (auto). 40 passed, ruff clean.
thanks for the quick update. approved!
